analysis.reason: 직전 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI 43.6으로 중립 구간 횡보 지속. ADX 31.0으로 뚜렷한 추세 유지하나, +DI 23.1, -DI 31.9로 하락 압력 우위. MACD 히스토그램 개선세는 긍정적이나 추세 전환 확정 신호 미흡. 5일 평균 대비 거래량 비율 1.33으로 움직임에 힘 실림. 스윙 지지선 68,045원, 저항선 80,380원 사이 횡보 구간. 4시간봉 RSI 45.8로 회복세 보이나 일봉·주봉과의 다중 시간대 정렬 미흡. 변동성 ATR 7,666원(9.76%)으로 손절폭 1.3배(9,966원) 설정 시, 목표가 2.6배(19,932원) 설정 시 손익비 1.5 이상 충족 가능. 그러나 추세 전환 확정 신호 부재로 관망 유지.
analysis.reasonEn: Previous 3 trading days maintained a wait-and-see approach. RSI remains in the neutral zone at 43.6. ADX shows a clear trend at 31.0, but with -DI at 31.9 and +DI at 23.1, downward pressure is dominant. MACD histogram improvement is positive but lacks confirmation of a trend reversal. Volume ratio at 1.33 indicates momentum behind the move. Trading within the 68,045 support and 80,380 resistance range. 4H RSI shows recovery at 45.8, but multi-timeframe alignment with daily/weekly is insufficient. Volatility ATR at 7,666 (9.76%) allows for a 1.3x ATR stop loss (9,966) and 2.6x ATR target (19,932) for a 1.5+ risk/reward ratio. However, due to the absence of confirmed trend reversal signals, a wait-and-see stance is maintained.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 78,550) vs SMA5/20/50 (KRW 72,335/84,603/98,648): Above short-term SMA5, below mid-term SMA20/50, indicating consolidation.
· Significantly below SMA100/200 (KRW 124,960/112,769): Mid-to-long-term trend remains weak.
· 52-week position (25.3%) + Current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (29.7→43.6): Exiting oversold, entering neutral zone, recovery confirmed.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-3318.0421→453.1190): Improving, attempting to enter neutral zone from weak convergence.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Mid-band KRW 84,603): Trading near mid-band, wide band width at 84.02%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (KRW 68,045): High relative to Pivot S1 (KRW 54,575) and SMA200 (KRW 112,769).
· Swing resistance (KRW 80,380): Close to current price, potential for short-term bounce on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low patterns: Consolidation, no clear Higher Low or Lower High pattern formed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.33x): Momentum behind the move, increased reliability.
· Current phase diagnosis: Accumulation phase, potential for buy on short-term resistance breakout, but lack of confirmed trend reversal signals warrants a wait-and-see approach.
